Welcome to Acme Analytics

Why Acme Analytics

Acme Analytics provides a deterministic analysis engine that fetches a single website, normalizes its HTML once, and runs independent analyzers across SEO, technical health, content, accessibility, and performance dimensions. Every finding carries observable evidence so teams can verify results without trusting an opaque black box.

Because the scoring engine is fully deterministic, the same website analyzed twice produces identical scores. This makes regressions easy to track: a change to the page either moves the score or it does not, and the version metadata tells you exactly which analyzer and scoring revisions produced the result.

Get started

Create a project, add a website, and run your first analysis in under a minute. The audit covers everything from missing meta descriptions and heading hierarchy to security response headers and static performance signals such as script counts and image dimensions.

No browser automation is required for the core audit. The engine deliberately fetches only the main HTML document, keeping the attack surface small and the analysis fast, reliable, and repeatable across environments.
